name: Upright Piano
maker: FreePats: recorded by Gonzalo and Roberto, edited by Roberto
licence_quote: Published under the terms of the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 public domain dedication.
source: FreePats Upright Piano KW, version 2022-02-21 (SFZ + FLAC)
notes: FreePats' full Upright Piano KW: every key, both velocity layers (1-80, 81-127); the bass notes loop, the treble plays out

loop_end is the source's less one in all 34 loops: the source writes the frame after the loop, and its files hold the loop's first frames again from there (measured), where SFZ and the DAW name the loop's last frame; read as written, every wrap played the loop's first frame twice
3 regions had a fixed low-pass (fil_type=lpf_2p, cutoff); it is applied to their samples (ffmpeg, 2-pole) since the DAW reads no filter opcodes
dropped width at its SFZ default (no effect)
volume lowered by 1.05 dB so a full-velocity note peaks at or below -1 dBFS (its loudest note reaches +0.05 dBFS when resampled)
